mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_ID, USER_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, PRICE, PRODUCT_CATEGORY, DESCRIPTION, PRODUCT_ADDRESS, PRODUCT_LAT, PRODUCT_LNG, PRODUCT_PLACE_ID, PRODUCT_REGDATE, PRODUCT_STATUS ) VALUES ( PRODUCT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{productCategory}, #{description}, #{productAddress}, #{productLat}, #{productLng}, #{productPlaceId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'AVAILABLE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET PRODUCT_NAME = #{productName}, PRICE = #{price}, PRODUCT_CATEGORY = #{productCategory}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, PRODUCT_ADDRESS = #{productAddress}, PRODUCT_LAT = #{productLat}, PRODUCT_LNG = #{productLng}, PRODUCT_PLACE_ID = #{productPlaceId} WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME, u.USER_EMAIL AS USER_EMAIL, p.PRODUCT_STATUS AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(p.PRODUCT_REGDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRODUCT_REGDATE FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID, p.USER_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRICE, p.PRODUCT_CATEGORY, p.DESCRIPTION, p.PRODUCT_ADDRESS, p.PRODUCT_LAT, p.PRODUCT_LNG, p.PRODUCT_PLACE_ID, p.PRODUCT_REGDATE, p.PRODUCT_STATUS, u.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME, u.USER_EMAIL AS USER_EMAIL, TO_CHAR(p.PRODUCT_REGDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRODUCT_REGDATE FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID ORDER BY p.PRODUCT_REGDATE DESC

SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID, p.USER_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRICE, p.PRODUCT_CATEGORY, p.DESCRIPTION, p.PRODUCT_ADDRESS, p.PRODUCT_LAT, p.PRODUCT_LNG, p.PRODUCT_PLACE_ID, p.PRODUCT_REGDATE, p.PRODUCT_STATUS, u.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME FROM PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT MAX(PRODUCT_ID) FROM PRODUCT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
